content.title: Oklahoma City Thunder vs Los Angeles Lakers Live Stream: How To Watch NBA
content.text: LeBron James and the shorthanded Los Angeles Lakers host Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder for the final time this season on Tuesday. Just five days ago, the Oklahoma City Thunder (62-16) routed the Los Angeles Lakers (50-28). The teams face-off for the final time this season on Tuesday, but with Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves on the sidelines. That leaves just LeBron James to take on the reigning champions, who are playing as well as any team in the league right now. Oklahoma City has won five straight. Over the last two games, Oklahoma City has put up 185 total points. They cruised to wins over Los Angeles and the Utah Jazz by a combined 78 points. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander led the way with another MVP performance in the win over Los Angeles. The reigning MVP led the way with 28 points, seven assists and seven rebounds on 12-of-25 shooting in just 29 minutes. Gilgeous-Alexander followed that up with 20 points in 24 minutes, as Oklahoma City rolled past Utah. Oklahoma City has just four games left on the schedule, three on the road, before a regular season finale against the Phoenix Suns. With three more wins, Oklahoma City would become just the third team in NBA history with back-to-back seasons of 65 wins or more.
